package.author: Christoph Gockel
package.description: An opinionated linter and formatter for Markdown.

en-US.author: Christoph Gockel
en-US.description: An opinionated linter and formatter for Markdown.
en-US.longDescription:
markdown-style checks Markdown against a fixed set of conventions.
The main one is a sentence per line, which keeps a diff to the sentences that actually changed rather than reflowing a whole paragraph.
The rest is ordinary tidiness: consistent heading and list markers, no trailing whitespace, predictable blank lines.
There is no configuration. You point it at a file, it tells you what is off and why, and it can fix most of it for you.
en-US.name: markdown-style
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- A Scoop bucket at very-good-software-ltd/scoop-bucket, so Windows users can install and update with scoop install very-good-software/markdown-style.
  The bucket regenerates its manifests from the latest release, the way the Homebrew tap does.

Fixed
- sentence-per-line no longer runs a sentence ending in the word "no" into the line below.
  "no." was on the abbreviation list for "No. 5", so it now only abbreviates when a number follows it.
- sentence-per-line now reports the line that actually has to move.
  When a paragraph only needed joining, the flag always landed on the paragraph's second line, whatever line the join happened on.
